title: CAISO TH_NP15_GEN-APND: real-time prices by time of day
subtitle: Median 15-minute price at peak (16:00 to 20:59 local) minus the median at midday (12:00 to 15:59 local), each 7-day window, 2026-08-27 to 2026-10-29, USD/MWh
source_line: Source: CAISO, ERCOT, MISO, SPP via the Energy Research Warehouse (ERW), table iso_rtm_hub_prices; data retrieved to 2026-10-30.
citations: California Independent System Operator (CAISO); Electric Reliability Council of Texas (ERCOT); Midcontinent Independent System Operator (MISO); Southwest Power Pool (SPP). Historical RTM Load Zone and Hub Prices; OASIS Interval Locational Marginal Prices, real-time dispatch (RTD, 5-minute); RTBM LMP by Settlement Location, 5-minute; Real-Time Final Market LMP, hourly (daily csv) [PAUSED 2026-10-04: MISO's terms forbid automated access; pulls paused pending a review of MISO's terms by a person (docs/methods/miso_pause.md)]; Real-Time Preliminary Ex-Post LMP, hourly (daily csv) [PAUSED 2026-10-04: MISO's terms forbid automated access; pulls paused pending a review of MISO's terms by a person (docs/methods/miso_pause.md)]; Settlement Point Prices at Resource Nodes, Hubs and Load Zones. Via the Energy Research Warehouse (ERW), table `iso_rtm_hub_prices`, ERW commit 75b92b7b4c20.
facts: CAISO TH_NP15_GEN-APND real-time prices, 2026-09-29 to 2026-10-29 (30 days): median overnight (21:00 to 11:59 local) 46.81, midday (12:00 to 15:59 local) 36.94, peak (16:00 to 20:59 local) 55.33 USD/MWh.
Peak minus midday median, 2026-10-23 to 2026-10-29: 25.22 USD/MWh.
